column1: # Speller errors attested in the corpus.
# Generated data. Do not edit by hand: hand-collected pairs belong in
# which reads the running text of corpus-sma and reports the error forms
# of typos-generated-err.tsv that actually occur there.
# Only pairs absent from typos.tsv are listed, so the two files stay
# disjoint. Sentence context is deliberately not stored here: it is
# corpus text, and duplicating it in a language repository is what the
# build-time corpus discovery exists to avoid. Regenerate it when needed.
